_comment: 🧩️ This subset's own contribution. A mutation vocabulary belongs to ONE subset of ONE standard of ONE artifact, so the oracle registration and the catalog live here rather than in a shared manifest. `en1993-1-any` is generated from each triad leaf's own `SemanticDescriptor.kind`, in `#[derive(dsl::Mutations)]`'s declaration order, and `kinds_match_the_enum_and_the_catalog` in `../🧬️schema/🧬️mutations/🦀️.rs` fails the moment this list and the enum part company.

oracles.rationale:
🐍️ No third-party library in any ecosystem reads or writes `s.norm.en1993` — checked against PyPI, which serves no `en1993`, `eurocode`, `vdi3805` or `iso16757` distribution, and whose nearest real packages (`structuralcodes`, `concreteproperties`, `anastruct`) implement design-code formulae and speak no interchange format — so this subset's reference is a SECOND IMPLEMENTATION rather than a third-party distribution. That is why `package` is empty: the entry links no external library and contributes nothing to the dependency ratchet. The implementation is `../../../../../🧪️tests/mutate-en1993-1/🐍️component.py`, all 49 kinds of `En1993Mutation` written in Python from `26/08/12/SEMANTIC-MUTATIONS-OVERHAUL`'s `📓️taxonomy.md` (verb table, the `new_<field>` naming mechanic, the addressing convention) and `📓️derivation-rules.md` (shape rules), plus this manifest's own catalog for the closed list of kinds. It imports nothing from the Rust it judges and transliterates none of it — the field a `new*` argument names is resolved by normalised spelling against the document's own keys, exactly as the naming mechanic states. Its reading is pinned by reaching every committed handcrafted `(before, mutation, after, outcome)` vector and by re-emitting the committed `.dsl.semio` artifact byte for byte, neither of which a misreading could do.

UNDER PROTOCOL V2 this registration is classified `cross-semio-implementation` — a required SUPPLEMENTAL oracle that does not discharge `en1993-1-mutate`'s external-oracle requirement for its 49-kind mutation vocabulary; a qualifying third-party reference (`third-party-library` / `third-party-cli` / `standards-reference-tool`) is still owed.

[2026-09-02, D1 — SEPARATE-ARTIFACT-STANDARD-SUBSET-IMPLEMENTATIONS-AND-FIXTURE-TEST-EVERY-MUTATION] Promoted from cross-semio-implementation to verified-native-second-implementation: this artifact is semio-native (isSemioNativeArtifact), this reference's own third-party survey above (kept verbatim) already names what was checked and declined, its python implementation differs from the Rust subject, and it covers 100% of this manifest's 1 capability/capabilities with 65 committed fixture vector(s). See .🧬semio/🦑️repo/🎫️tickets/🎆️26/🌙️09/☀️02/SEPARATE-ARTIFACT-STANDARD-SUBSET-IMPLEMENTATIONS-AND-FIXTURE-TEST-EVERY-MUTATION/📓️d1-native-oracle-discharge.md.

oracles.rationale: 🐍️ Independent-formulation compliance oracle of EN1993: the python compliance script recomputes the Rust check chain and the shared harness (`✏️s/🔌️plugins/📕️norm/🔮️oracles/🏃️harness`) replays blessed oracle cases against the third-party references claimed in the norm root registry (`norm-eurocode-structuralcodes`, `-concreteproperties`, `-sectionproperties`, `-blue-prints`, `-sympy`, `-groundhog`, scipy numerics). Labelled honestly as independent formulation, not third-party validation, wherever no library covers the clause. The document-level script `🔮️oracles/🚦️check-outcome/🐍️.py` recomputes the per-check utilisations of a committed snapshot (check-outcome case).

Reference values of the EN1993 oracle case files (`🧪️tests/🧫️fixtures/🔮️oracle-cases/third-party*.json`) for the checks en1993.5.2.alpha-cr-storey, mechanics.beam-continuous, mechanics.portal-sway are computed by anastruct 1.7.0. The harness adapter `✏️s/🔌️plugins/📕️norm/🔮️oracles/🏃️harness/🔌️adapters/anastruct/🐍️.py` is the only importer; values are blessed from the library, never from the Rust. National Annex parameters are inputs of the cases.

Reference values of the EN1993 oracle case files (`🧪️tests/🧫️fixtures/🔮️oracle-cases/third-party*.json`) for the checks en1993.5.2.alpha-cr, en1993.6.10.nc-rd, en1993.6.14.mc-rd-class3, en1993.6.2.av-channel, en1993.6.2.av-chs, en1993.6.2.av-rhs-depth, en1993.6.2.av-rolled-i, en1993.6.2.mc-rd-class12, en1993.6.2.my-n-rd, en1993.6.2.my-v-rd, en1993.6.2.npl, en1993.6.2.vpl-rd, en1993.6.21.tau-i, en1993.6.3.mb-rd, en1993.6.32.mnrd-rectangular, en1993.6.39.aw-hollow, en1993.6.39.mnyrd-hollow, en1993.6.7.nu-rd are computed by blue-prints 0.8.0. The harness adapter `✏️s/🔌️plugins/📕️norm/🔮️oracles/🏃️harness/🔌️adapters/blueprints/🐍️.py` is the only importer; values are blessed from the library, never from the Rust. National Annex parameters are inputs of the cases.

Independent formulations (numerical integration, root finding, eigenproblems and closed-form derivations that never reuse the rust expression) of the EN1993 oracle case files (`🧪️tests/🧫️fixtures/🔮️oracle-cases/third-party*.json`) for the checks en1993.1-8.4.5.weld-group-box, en1993.5.2.alpha-cr-eigen, en1993.5.2.alpha-cr-storey, en1993.5.3.2.sway-imperfection, en1993.section.chs, en1993.section.rhs-sharp are computed by scipy 1.18.0.
